description: UK VAT: must register when taxable turnover in the last 12 rolling months goes over £90,000, or is expected to go over £90,000 in the next 30 days alone; can deregister under £88,000; Flat Rate Scheme can be joined with expected turnover up to £150,000 excluding VAT and must be left over £230,000 including VAT; rates 20%, 5%, 0%. United Kingdom, as of 2026-11-21 (gov.uk and legislation.gov.uk). Income Tax bands are for England, Wales and Northern Ireland; Scottish bands are not calculated. General information and estimates only; not personal tax advice, no agent services and no filing with HMRC.
